evidence.label: account
evidence.query: query Explorer($address: String!) { account(address: $address) { address  balance  nonce  firstSeenBlock  lastSeenBlock  txCount  } }

evidence.label: inferenceSpend
evidence.query: query Explorer($address: String!) { inferenceSpend(address: $address) { address  totalSpentRaw  channelCount  settledChannels  } }

evidence.label: inferenceReceived
evidence.query: query Explorer($address: String!) { inferenceReceived(address: $address) { address  totalReceivedRaw  settledChannels  } }

evidence.label: htlcPaid
evidence.query: query Explorer($address: String!) { htlcPaid(address: $address) { address  totalPaidRaw  htlcCount  } }

evidence.label: htlcReceived
evidence.query: query Explorer($address: String!) { htlcReceived(address: $address) { address  totalReceivedRaw  htlcCount  } }

evidence.label: htlcs
evidence.query: query Explorer($address: String, $limit: Int, $offset: Int) { htlcs(address: $address, limit: $limit, offset: $offset) { hashLock  htlcId  sender  recipient  amount  timeout  status  paymentStatus  evidenceStatus  verifierRef  timeoutPath  observationHead  preImage  gnUsed  receiptHash  createdAt  settledAt  refundedAt  blockHash  blockNumber  } }

evidence.label: positionsAsSponsor
evidence.query: query Explorer($sponsor: String, $limit: Int, $offset: Int) { sponsorPositions(sponsor: $sponsor, limit: $limit, offset: $offset) { id  role  positionId  sponsor  operator  amount  remainingPrincipal  status  unlockBlock  rewardPolicy  startedBlock  updatedBlock  updatedAt  } }

evidence.label: positionsAsOperator
evidence.query: query Explorer($operator: String, $limit: Int, $offset: Int) { sponsorPositions(operator: $operator, limit: $limit, offset: $offset) { id  role  positionId  sponsor  operator  amount  remainingPrincipal  status  unlockBlock  rewardPolicy  startedBlock  updatedBlock  updatedAt  } }

evidence.label: minerReliability
evidence.query: query Explorer($miner: String!) { minerReliability(miner: $miner) { miner  settledCount  settledVolumeGn  timeoutCount  voidedCount  forceOpenExpiredCount  lastFailedAcks  offerOpenFailedCount  lastFailedOfferOpens  offerOpenFailureEvidence  ghost { issued  completed  expired  incorrect  } tripwireRejections  disputesOpened  fraudUpheld  } }

notes: Indexer balance and the balance tool are separate observations. Frozen balance is unavailable when omitted. Address syntax is checked; the SS58 checksum is not.
HTLCs and sponsor positions are first pages only. Empty pages are not proof of no historic activity.

lookups.label: account
lookups.query: query Explorer($address: String!) { account(address: $address) { address  balance  nonce  firstSeenBlock  lastSeenBlock  txCount  } }
